concept:
Greenhouse: a plant-care tracker.  Staff record plants with a
moisture reading and log waterings; the page shows which plants need
water and lets staff add a watering.

entities.name: Plant
Watering

invariants.statement: needsWater(moisture) is true exactly when the moisture reading is below 30 (30 itself is healthy).

clauses: Read amount with Number; when not an integer in 1..500 return 400 'Amount must be 1-500'.
Call db.plant.findUnique where id body.plantId; when missing return 404 'Plant not found'.
Call db.watering.create with data amount, plantId.
Return NextResponse.json with watering and status 201.
Export GET. Read searchParams from new URL(request.url).
Call db.plant.findMany where name contains q (when q is null no where filter).

ui.name: GreenhousePage
clauses: A 'use client' page that fetches plants from /api/plants on mount and keeps them in state.
Renders each plant's name, room, moisture and a needs-water badge from needsWater(moisture).
A watering form: a plant picker, an amount input, and an 'Add watering' button that POSTs to /api/waterings.
On 4xx responses show the error message from the body; on success refresh the plant list.
Show 'Loading…' while fetching and an error retry button when the initial fetch fails.
